:::{#exr-subspace-zero-practice}
#### Testing whether $p_1 + p_2 = 1$ defines a subspace

A coin toss can land heads or tails,
and the [probabilities](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) $p_1$ and $p_2$ of those two results satisfy $p_1 + p_2 = 1$.
That condition defines the [set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-set)

$$
\mathcal{P} = \cb{(p_1, p_2) \in \reals^2 : p_1 + p_2 = 1}.
$$

Is $\mathcal{P}$ a [subspace](#def-subspace) of $\reals^2$?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Use @thm-subspace-zero.

:::
